scope: Targeted historical share-basis bridges for six verified 2012 split events; not an exhaustive corporate-action or issuer-scope audit.

adjustments.rationale: The February 23, 2012 annual filing reports 2009/2010/2011 diluted EPS of 2.93/5.06/3.69, before the subsequent 2-for-1 split. Convert the entire selected history and eps0 to the December 31, 2012 nominal share basis by multiplying EPS by 0.5; do not modify year-end price. The issuer announcement specifies July 27 record date and August 10 distribution; Eurex specifies August 13 ex-date.

The February 28 filing precedes the five-for-one split distributed July 20; split-adjusted trading began July 23. Multiply all selected historical EPS and eps0 by 0.2, leaving the year-end price unchanged. Official FAQ was read via web; direct archival download returned HTTP 403.

The July 24 annual filing precedes the two-for-one split distributed December 24 with adjusted trading December 26. Apply 0.5 to every selected annual EPS and eps0, keeping the December 31 price unchanged.

The February 28 annual filing precedes the one-for-three reverse split immediately before the July 2 Progress Energy merger. Multiply all selected historical EPS and eps0 by 3; this only fixes share units and does not reconstruct the merged business earnings. Official announcement and SEC 8-K corroborate the action; direct archival download failed with SSL EOF.

The March 22 annual filing precedes the two-for-one split distributed June 26. Multiply all selected historical EPS and eps0 by 0.5, keeping the year-end price unchanged. This is the distribution date, not an asserted ex-trading date.

The February 21 annual filing precedes the two-for-one split distributed June 1; adjusted trading began June 4. Multiply every selected annual EPS and eps0 by 0.5, leaving the year-end price unchanged.

reviewed_no_adjustment.rationale: The same annual report explicitly restates comparative share/EPS data for the 2011 2-for-1 split. Its total diluted EPS is 2.04/2.55/2.63 for 2009/2010/2011, matching the current input. Repeated split ratio facts are contexts for the same historical split, not separate actions to multiply together.

The same annual report states all share and per-share data are restated for the May 20, 2011 2-for-1 split. Diluted EPS 1.63/0.52/0.91 matches the current input. Its split_facts values of USD 55000 are equity accounting entries, not split factors.
reviewed_no_adjustment.evidence_access: Read via web search/open; full source bytes not archived by this reviewer.

reviewed_no_adjustment.rationale: The selected March 27 annual filing was published after the February 2, 2012 2-for-1 split and explicitly adjusts all historical per-share amounts. The current 1.42/1.65/1.93 diluted EPS values are already split-adjusted. Later quarterly split accounting adjustments do not imply another split.

reviewed_no_adjustment.rationale: The 2011 annual report has diluted EPS 1.95/1.83/1.98 and comparative diluted shares 117.5/119.2/119.4 million. The contemporaneous 2010 year-end release explicitly states all share and per-share amounts are adjusted for the May 27, 2010 2-for-1 split. The split facts are 2010 equity/share entries, not 2012 actions.

reviewed_no_adjustment.rationale: The August 17 annual filing follows the January 20 two-for-one split. Its accounting policies explicitly restate all prior-year per-share amounts; 2010/2011/2012 diluted EPS 1.19/1.74/2.16 matches the selected input. No second adjustment.
reviewed_no_adjustment.evidence_access: Official annual report read through web search; raw PDF not archived.

limitations: An empty split_facts array does not establish that no split occurred: KO is a confirmed counterexample.
DERA fact ddate can denote a financial context rather than the split's effective or ex-date.
Facts denominated in USD or shares are not conversion ratios.
This review only resolves the named split events; it does not certify all share-basis, restructuring, or issuer comparability.
Keep share_basis_verified false: named split fixes are not complete company-action certification.
Known spin-offs, acquisitions and discontinued operations require separate normalized EPS work; this experiment intentionally retains the as-reported scenario and flags it.
All multipliers apply once to the exact expected accession; apply to base EPS and every selected history observation, not year-end nominal price.

The 478 normalized histories contain 476 three-year series, one one-year series (LYB), and one two-year series (CCE). At most two growth observations means the model uses its annual sigma floor, rather than estimating historical variance.
High loss exclusion at 25 percent is a model rule. The 6 percent prior with strength 10 gives 3-year loss probabilities of 4.62, 12.31, 20.00, or 27.69 percent; these are not calibrated risks.

review_notes.note: 2012 Phillips 66 spin-off changes business scope. Pre-spin annual EPS contains downstream earnings while December price refers to retained COP; a stock-split multiplier cannot repair that economic mismatch. Results remain an as-reported historical extrapolation, not a continuing-business forecast.

October 1, 2012 Kraft Foods Group spin-off changes business scope. Pre-spin annual history belongs to the combined Kraft business while December MDLZ price refers to retained snacks operations. No arbitrary EPS allocation or share multiplier is applied.

September 28, 2012 ADT and flow-control separation changes business scope; selected GAAP total diluted EPS can contain discontinued operations even in a post-separation annual filing. No continuing-operations normalization is claimed.
Reverse-split share alignment is repaired, but the Progress Energy merger changes business scope and dilution; multiplying historical EPS by three does not create combined-company pro-forma earnings.
